title: Calderwick Police's planning figure for its Tanner Street custody hub in 2027-28, the detentions the hub will book in its first year, with the remand holds and initial health assessments its fit-out is sized from
subdomain: municipal service demand and resource allocation (a public service's first-year demand at a new site from its demand model over the site's catchment, completed by a second agency's caseload booked into the operator's facility)
prompt_shape: one figure to the nearest 250 with its two parts and a chart; remand cell hours and holds over 24 hours by suite; initial health assessments by suite, day and night

distractors.why_relevant: the estates register of the four suites and Tanner Street: cells, children's cells, interview and medical rooms, status
distractors.why_unused: it records the estate, not demand or detentions; no figure reads it

distractors.why_relevant: the wards' mid-2024 population, a natural driver for a demand per head
distractors.why_unused: the custody demand model is built on arrests, not population; no figure reads it

distractors.why_relevant: the premises licensed past midnight in the city centre wards, where night-time arrests come from
distractors.why_unused: the arrest records already carry the wards' arrests; no figure reads it

distractors.why_relevant: the bank holidays on which the remand courts do not sit
distractors.why_unused: the remand files carry each handover time; no figure reads it
